description: Core permissions for the Zumi preview MAIN webview: the window.zumi shim uses event.listen (core:event) and invokes the app-defined rpc + guest_* commands. build.rs's AppManifest makes the ACL apply to app commands, so each one must be granted here. Scoped by WEBVIEW label only (gate 11 change 6): every guest is a child webview of window `main`, so a `windows: [main]` match would hand core:default (event emit/listen) to any guest on a local URL. A guest webview gets no capability from this file.
